# The Metashield The possible and common threats within the sector and their overall goal is well known by the crew. Crew do NOT however, know exactly the abilities of, or the specific goals of, any antagonist. When attempting to figure out what is and isn't shielded ask yourself this: "Is it logical for my character to know this?". For example: It is logical to assume a secretive and violent cult is a threat to the station. It is NOT logical to know what each of their spells are or do exactly without witnessing it yourself. Not everyone can know everything ever so avoid knowing everything and anything not mentioned.
It is excusable to know certain information due to lore based reasons however abusing this fact will be met with swift punishment. Do note the intent of a character knowing otherwise shielded knowledge is roleplaying, and can be seen as powergaming if this is abused. If you have a question on if something is excusable ahelp or make a ticket in the discord!
Your character may discover the existence of certain shielded knowledge during a round. It should be noted Central Command often employs mind altering technology to cover up otherwise sensitive data. This is generally antagonist specifics your character would not know logically and CSOP. CSOP may never be remembered unless directly approved by an admin.
## A few notes on specific antagonists and items:
Changelings are a common folk tale across the galaxy but it is known that there is some truth to the stories of Changelings infiltrating stations. When considering Changelings consider the fact the story your character heard is most likely mostly myth, changed from its original version over decades of being spread across the galaxy from person to person.
When considering the shield for magic users remember that things such as cults are often very strict about information, it is incredibly rare to have insider knowledge of how magic users and cults function.
High-tech "Chameleon" technology is known about and utilized across the galaxy. Exactly how to configure a "Chameleon" item is unknown to you unless you are the owner of said item, or have been shown by the owner how to configure it. As such you cannot tell if an item is "Chameleon" technology or not without seeing it in action. This does not prevent being suspicious of if an item is fake, fraudulent, or stolen, esspecially if it is high value.
Implants are common across the galaxy and it is safe to assume one has an implant if there is little to no other explanation, or if the explanation is less logically sound. The steep consequences for attempting to extract an absent implant are well known and documented, one should think very carefully and consider the evidence before attempting to withdrawl an implant. The exact implants available to Syndicate agents are shielded until seen.
The fact that an item can be something other than what its visual appearance and examine description indicate it logically should be able to do is shielded. This covers items such as hypopens, explosive pens, hypodarts, and other unmarked stealth items. This shield is lifted when you witness an item behaving in a way it shouldn't logically. When lifting this shield the reveal only applies to the specific item in question, though you may begin to be suspicious of other items. For the sake of balancing and to avoid powergaming/metgaming stealth items are never remembered.
## Metafriending and Metagrudging This section provides additional information on a concept that is prohibited by multiple metashield items that are never revealed IC. Giving a person or character preferential treatment based on something that your character should not know is considered metafriending. Treating a person or character negatively based on something that your character should not know is considered metagrudging.
This does NOT prohibit inter-round friendships, rivalries, and/or remembering past (canon) shifts. However note that consecutive shifts are not immediately one after eachother and a noteable amount of time may have passed, in which emotions have most likely faded, however grudges may still be held.
## Metafriending Examples These are all examples of things that are prohibited by at least one metashield item that is never revealed IC. - Giving a character additional access or a job because you are friends with the player who is playing that character. - Trusting a character because you are friends with the player who is playing that character. - Not fighting a character because you are friends with the player who is playing that character. - Ignoring your objective to kill a character because your character and theirs became friends in a previous round. Though some emotional reluctance may be shown for roleplay purposes. - Two characters swiftly going from friendly with eachother to two characters willing to die for eachother because you are friends with the player who is playing the character.
## Metagrudging Examples These are all examples of things that are prohibited by at least one metashield item that is never revealed IC. - Not giving a character additional access or a job because you are mad at or don't like the player who is playing that character. - Not trusting a character because you are mad at or don't like the player who is playing that character. - Starting a fight with a character because of something that they did last round. Note again that consecutive shifts are not immediately after eachother and a decent amount of time has most likely passed. Grudges may still be held. - Starting a fight with a character because they killed you while you were playing a different character. - Targeting or harassing a character based on anything which the character's player did while not playing the character.
